sections.title: Outfits
sections.note: 38 outfits, including the two from the free Ver. 2.0.0 update.

items.name: Bear Minimum
items.howTo: You start the game wearing it.
items.reward: Double damage and one fewer Heart Container.
items.notes: Link's default outfit. Since Ver. 2.1.0, after 30 Hero Points it also gives two extra Heart Containers and a high chance to dodge, but still double damage (Zelda Wiki).

items.name: Hero's Tunic
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Hytopian Silk, 0 Rupees.
items.reward: No special ability.
items.notes: Sir Combsly gives you the Hytopian Silk when you first enter Hytopia Castle, and won't let you into the Drablands without the tunic.

items.name: Kokiri Clothes
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Blob Jelly, 1 Armos Spirit, 100 Rupees.
items.reward: Shoot three arrows at once with the Bow.

items.name: Big Bomb Outfit
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Armos Spirit, 1 Tektite Shell, 100 Rupees.
items.reward: Bombs become Big Bombs.

items.name: Legendary Dress
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Tektite Shell, 1 Sweet Shroom, 200 Rupees.
items.reward: Hearts appear more often.

items.name: Lucky Loungewear
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Sweet Shroom, 1 Blin Bling, 1 Gohma's Eye, 200 Rupees.
items.reward: Dodge 25% of attacks.

items.name: Zora Costume
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Fresh Kelp, 1 Zora Scale, 400 Rupees.
items.reward: Swim faster and against strong currents; hurt enemies by swimming into them.

items.name: Torrent Robe
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Fresh Kelp, 1 Hytopian Silk, 1 Aqua Crown, 600 Rupees.
items.reward: Doubles the size of the Water Rod's pillar.
items.notes: IGN lists 2 Fresh Kelp; Zelda Wiki (outfit list and the Torrent Robe page) says 1.

items.name: Jack of Hearts
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Hytopian Silk, 1 Octorok Sucker, 1 Fairy Dust, 600 Rupees.
items.reward: One extra Heart Container.

items.name: Goron Garb
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Goron Ore, 1 Monster Guts, 600 Rupees.
items.reward: Swim in lava and pass through fire unharmed.

items.name: Boomeranger
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Goron Ore, 1 Demon Fossil, 1 Rugged Horn, 800 Rupees.
items.reward: Bigger Boomerang that passes through foes and can carry two Links.

items.name: Energy Gear
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Monster Guts, 1 Demon Fossil, 1 Kodongo Tail, 1 Keese Wing, 800 Rupees.
items.reward: Energy Gauge +50%.

items.name: Cozy Parka
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Fluffy Fuzz, 1 Serpent Fangs, 800 Rupees.
items.reward: Grip on ice and can't be frozen.

items.name: Tingle Tights
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Fluffy Fuzz, 1 Tiny Snowflake, 1 Freezard Water, 1000 Rupees.
items.reward: Three balloons; each one saves you from a fall.

items.name: Hammerwear
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Tiny Snowflake, 1 Crimson Shell, 1 Freezard Water, 1 Chill Stone, 1000 Rupees.
items.reward: Faster, twice as strong Magic Hammer with a shock wave.

items.name: Cheer Outfit
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 3 Frilly Fabric, 100 Rupees.
items.after: When the Street Merchant opens (after three levels or challenges)
items.reward: Allies' Energy Gauges +50% (all three in single-player).
items.notes: Frilly Fabric is sold only by the Street Merchant (3000 Rupees each, Zelda Wiki).

items.name: Sword Suit
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Stiff Puff, 1 Silver Thread, 1 Royal Ring, 1000 Rupees.
items.after: After the Water, Fire and Ice Temples
items.reward: Sword beams at full health; double sword damage.

items.name: Rupee Regalia
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Royal Ring, 1 Antique Coin, 1 Fancy Fabric, 1200 Rupees.
items.after: After the Water, Fire and Ice Temples
items.reward: Rupees appear more often, and in pairs.

items.name: Queen of Hearts
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Mystery Jade, 1 Fairy Dust, 1 Star Fragment, 1 Exquisite Lace, 1200 Rupees.
items.after: After the Water, Fire and Ice Temples
items.reward: Three extra Heart Containers.

items.name: Dunewalker Duds
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Palm Cone, 1 Ancient Fin, 1 Stal Skull, 1200 Rupees.
items.reward: Walk on quicksand.

items.name: Light Armor
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Carrumpkin, 1 Spider Silk Lace, 1 Poe Soul, 1200 Rupees.
items.reward: Lights the area around you; burns other Links in the Coliseum.
items.notes: Needed to read Drablands Diary Vol. 7 in the Street Merchant's tent.

items.name: Gust Garb
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Vintage Linen, 1 Gibdo Bandage, 1 Sandy Ribbon, 1500 Rupees.
items.reward: Faster, longer Gust Jar blasts.

items.name: Ninja Gi
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Rainbow Coral, 1 Ancient Fin, 1 Vintage Linen, 1 Gibdo Bandage, 1 Stal Skull, 1500 Rupees.
items.reward: Instant dash attack that does triple damage.

items.name: Fire Blazer
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Mystery Extract, 1 Twisted Twig, 1 Lava Drop, 1500 Rupees.
items.reward: Fire Gloves shoot three fireballs.

items.name: Serpent's Toga
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Ice Rose, 1 Carrumpkin, 1 Mystery Extract, 1 Poe Soul, 1 Twisted Twig, 1500 Rupees.
items.reward: Become an invulnerable statue while standing still.

items.name: Robowear
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Cucco Feathers, 1 Carmine Pearl, 1 Sky Dragon Tail, 1 Pretty Plume, 1500 Rupees.
items.after: After the Desert and Grim Temples
items.reward: Faster, stronger Gripshot that pulls enemies in.

items.name: Showstopper
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Vibrant Brooch, 1 Pretty Plume, 1 Mock Fairy, 1 Aurora Stone, 2000 Rupees.
items.after: After the Desert and Grim Temples
items.reward: Draws enemies' attention (no effect in single-player).

items.name: Spin Attack Attire
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Crystal Skull, 1 Sanctuary Mask, 1 Steel Mask, 2000 Rupees.
items.after: After the Desert and Grim Temples
items.reward: Great Spin Attack, unaffected by electric, fire and ice enemies.

items.name: Lady's Ensemble
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Lady's Glasses, 1 Lady's Collar, 1 Lady's Parasol, 0 Rupees.
items.after: Listed after the Forest Temple; craftable after the Sky Temple
items.reward: One extra Heart Container; Hearts appear more often. Lifts Princess Styla's curse.
items.notes: The three Lady's materials come from the first clears of the Forest Temple, The Lady's Lair and the Sky Temple. Wearing it into Hytopia Castle starts the ending.

items.name: Cursed Tights
items.howTo: Lift Princess Styla's curse with the Lady's Ensemble; King Tuft gives you the tights.
items.reward: Dodge 50% of attacks, but take double damage.
items.notes: King Tuft's reward once the curse is lifted (Zelda Wiki; IGN says talk to Princess Styla after beating the game). First named "Kinda Cursed Tights" (Prima uses that name).

items.name: Cacto Clothes
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Supple Leaf, 1 Thornberry, 1000 Rupees.
items.reward: Thorns hurt foes that touch you.
items.notes: The materials are King Tuft's rewards for all Woodlands and Riverside challenges, or Coliseum wins in those arenas.

items.name: Cheetah Costume
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Divine Whiskers, 1 Beastie Patch, 1 Brittle Papyrus, 1500 Rupees.
items.after: After the Water, Fire and Ice Temples
items.reward: Run faster.
items.notes: The materials are King Tuft's rewards for all Volcano, Ice Cavern and Fortress challenges, or Coliseum wins. Prima: it also lets you talk to the town's cats.

items.name: Sword Master Suit
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Golden Insect, 1 Gold Dust, 1 Fabled Butterfly, 2000 Rupees.
items.after: After the Desert and Grim Temples
items.reward: Sword beams at full health, double damage and double reach.
items.notes: The materials are King Tuft's rewards for all Dunes, Ruins and Sky Realm challenges, or Coliseum wins. IGN gives the price as 1500 Rupees; Zelda Wiki says 2000.

items.name: Linebeck's Uniform
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 1 Mystery Jade, 1 Aqua Crown, 1 Antique Coin, 1 Stal Skull, 1 Carmine Pearl, 3000 Rupees.
items.after: When the Den of Trials opens (nine levels or challenges cleared)
items.reward: See inside treasure chests; +10 seconds in timed challenges per Link wearing it.
items.notes: Added by the free Ver. 2.0.0 update (2 Dec 2015). The most expensive outfit.

items.name: Dapper Spinner
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 10 Freebie, 300 Rupees.
items.after: After losing five times at Daily Riches
items.reward: Quick Spin Attack by pressing B three times.
items.notes: Freebies come only from losing chests at Daily Riches, one try per real day, so it takes at least 12 days. IGN calls it the "Dapper Spinner Kit".

items.name: Fierce Deity Armor
items.howTo: Clear all 40 floors of the Den of Trials; it's in the chest at the bottom.
items.reward: Double sword damage, four sword beams, beams from Spin Attacks and no knockback.
items.notes: Found in the chest at the bottom (B40) of the Den of Trials on the first full clear. Added by Ver. 2.0.0.

items.name: Tri Suit
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 5 Friendly Token, 300 Rupees.
items.reward: When all three Links wear it: Energy +50%, dodge 25% of attacks, more Hearts and Rupees.
items.notes: The Faux Hero gives one Friendly Token per new player you clear a level with over local wireless or Download Play (15 at most). Since Ver. 2.0.0 the Street Merchant also sells them after the curse is lifted, at random (2000 Rupees each per Zelda Wiki; IGN says 3000).

items.name: Timeless Tunic
items.howTo: Order from Madame Couture: 3 Friendly Token, 100 Rupees.
items.reward: Music plays as chiptune versions.
items.notes: Friendly Tokens: see the Tri Suit.
